instructions_to_main_agent: IMPLEMENT DARK THEME ONLY. Do not use white backgrounds anywhere except for high-emphasis text. The base background must be a very deep #030303 or #050505.
Add 'Outfit' and 'Manrope' to the index.html via Google Fonts, and configure tailwind.config.js to use them as 'font-heading' and 'font-sans'.
Build the 20-item Sidebar navigation, grouped logically into sections (e.g. Workspace, Labs, Network) using Phosphor or Lucide icons. Ensure it uses custom-scrollbar to remain sleek.
For the 'Home Dashboard', design a Cinematic Hero section at the top featuring a background image with a dark gradient overlay and glowing effects. Do not use standard centered layout.
Ensure 'Project Cards' look like Netflix/Frame.io thumbnails: large 16:9 images, subtle gradients at the bottom, tight typography, hover scale effects.
Use standard Radix/Shadcn components for interactive logic (Tabs, Dialogs, Dropdowns) but style them with glassmorphism (bg-black/60, backdrop-blur-xl, border-white/10).
NEVER use generic icons or emojis. Use a consistent icon library (lucide-react).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons and navigational links.
Avoid standard Vercel/Stripe SaaS look. The UI should feel like professional film production software: robust, dark, high contrast, visually driven.
Mock the 'Sync Studio' with a visual waveform (using a stylized UI or canvas placeholder) and timeline tracks.
Implement the 'Story Lab' script editor area resembling a professional screenplay tool with a minimalist, distraction-free glass panel.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glass-morphism effects (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific elements excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. This disrupts natural reading flow.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
NEVER use placeholder text for images. Always rely on the provided image_urls.
